body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: A disused small canal lock converted into a refuge: thick closed timber gate, sunken dry lock floor, stone ledges and a boat reused for sleeping. The dungeon is reached through an unlit maintenance tunnel. COMPOSITION: Side cutaway with the huge gate at one edge and tiny living pockets stepped down the opposite wall. COLOR SCRIPT: blue-black water, pale weathered timber, restrained turquoise, warm ivory light. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
